mentions.name: Gusco
mentions.description: Gusco is a file manager that can run in the terminal as a Bubble Tea TUI or as a native-yet-texty app via Gio UI. It recently added an audio player, aimed at fellow file hoarders.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Still building the file manager I've always wanted: https://intestinate.com/gusco/

Added an audio player this past month for all fellow file hoarders out there.

Also, you can now choose if you want Gusco to live in your terminal or run as a native-yet-texty app.
mentions.author: gusco
